skill.name: Main clause and dependent clause
skill.why: Every sentence needs a main clause to stand on. Extra clauses just hang on.
skill.how: Say each part alone. If it works, it's main. If it leaves you hanging, it's dependent.

beats.say: Two doers, two actions. So two clauses.
Say this part alone. Does it work?
Yep! It stands on its own. That's the main clause.
This part leaves you hanging. When the joey sneezed... what?
It's a dependent clause. Like a joey, it can't go alone.

weDo.hint: Which part makes sense on its own?
weDo.success: 'The possum hid in my boot' makes sense by itself, so it's the main clause.

parts.reason: 'Because it was raining' leaves you waiting for more. It can't stand alone.

parts.tap: the possum hid in my boot.
